artifacts.title: Tufts University Non-Suite AI Tool Status Update
artifacts.summary: Calibrated re-crawl of the official TTS Generative AI Tools page under the verbatim_original_v2 snippet policy. The update captures previously missing negative-endorsement statuses: tools outside the TTS recommended and supported suite (ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Notebook LM, Grammarly, Perplexity, PlayLab.ai) are web-version-only on Tufts systems, cannot be installed or integrated into Tufts platforms, and are approved for Public data only. Existing recommended-suite claims remain valid and unchanged.
limitations: This tracker is not legal advice, not academic integrity advice, and not an official university statement unless a linked source is the university's own official page.
A tool's status on the TTS page reflects data-handling considerations only and does not override course-specific guidance.
